record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Dreepy (1 star) and Drakloak (2 stars) carry passive HATCH; Dragapult (3 stars) has no passive. All three are Dragon/Ghost, maxPP 100, range 2, and declare ABILITY DRAGON_DARTS. The HATCH passive (evolution by hatching) is not described here.
record.summary: Three darts at one target. The cast target takes three separate instances of flat special damage (10/20/40 by stars for the catalog units, requested per instance), all with the same crit result. If the target's hp is 0 or below after the third instance, the caster regains PP (40 for 1-3 stars, 80 from 4 stars; requested).

targeting.who: the cast target only, three times
targeting.note: requiresTarget keeps the default true. All three instances go to the same unit; there is no re-targeting between them, so later instances land on an already dead target and are ignored by handleDamage (hp <= 0 returns takenDamage 0).

effects.target: the cast target, three separate instances
effects.scaling: Requested amount per instance = table value (total 3 x). Each instance calls handleSpecialDamage(damage, board, SPECIAL, caster, crit) with the default apBoost = true: damage + damage x AP/100, then x2 if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (the effect is deleted after use, so only the first instance is doubled), x1.2 with the strange-steam board effect, then the crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault false; one roll, shared by the three instances).
effects.resolution: Requested 10/20/40 per instance is pre-defence. Each instance is reduced by the target's special defence (damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef), rounded up, minimum 1 per instance), and shield damage counts in takenDamage (core-mechanics.md section A). Blocked per instance by protect, skydiving, magicBounce (magicBounce reflects each blocked instance). Shiny Charm, Fossil shield and a Cover Band ally can absorb or redirect an instance (handleDamage branches seen, not traced here).

effects.scaling: Requested amount = table value. addPP(ppRegained, caster, 0, false): apBoost 0 and crit false, so AP and crit do not scale it.
effects.resolution: Applied: halved (round) if the caster has fatigue; applyTwistBandBuff only flips negative values, so it does nothing to this positive gain; the gain is skipped entirely if the caster is silenced, protected, has NO_PP_GAIN or is resurrecting; otherwise pp is clamped to 0..(2 x maxPP - 1). The condition is `target.hp <= 0` evaluated once after the loop, so it is also true if the target was already dead, or killed by a different source in between, and false if a Cover Band ally took the hits or a Shiny Charm saved the target. The pp was already spent (maxPP removed) by the base process before the darts.

starBehavior.note: Caster stars index both tables (1-4; fallback 80 for both). The damage figures are per instance, three instances per cast. The 80 PP refund exists only from 4 stars, which no catalog unit has.

record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 3 x 10/20/40 special damage (30/60/120 before AP, defence and shield) and a 40 PP refund on a kill. Damage applied: AP percentage, DOUBLE_DAMAGE (first instance only), strange steam and crit raise each instance before the target's special defence and shield; taken damage includes shield-absorbed damage, minimum 1 per instance. PP applied: fatigue and the silence/protect/NO_PP_GAIN guards, then the clamp.
